site.name: America Mine
overview: The America Mine is a historic silver-gold mine in the Lone Cone (Dunton) mining district of Dolores County. Federal mineral records identify it as a past producer associated with the patented America, Columbia, and Nil Desperandum claims.
timeline: During the historic mining era — The property was developed through the America, Columbia, and Nil Desperandum patented claims.
1910 — The federal mineral record lists the property's last reported production year.
moreHistory: Historic mining records describe four adits driven generally southeast and connected by raises. The documented lower-tunnel location identifies the historic mine site; this does not imply that an opening survives or is accessible today.
